objective: The fight screen: the shield button above the power plates with a shield icon; the dock centred on the left edge in a fight, its open column on screen; the wave result panel (with its three boon cards) centred along the bottom; the power bar small, just above the result panel; the KO counter in the top right corner.
acceptance_criteria: The shield button sits above the health bars, showing a shield icon and its F key
The wave result panel and its three boon cards sit centred along the bottom of the screen, clear of the power plates
During a fight the Menu button and its open column are centred on the left edge and the whole column is on screen
The power bar is 280 x 13, low in the middle, just above where the wave result panel opens
The KO counter sits in the top right corner, under the Admin button, out of the middle of the screen
